sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents (双蛇夫人 白赤练) is a story - region finale encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Threadbound Great Tree, after the mirror puzzle. Beating it yields White Serpent & Crimson Viper.

sections.title: Where to Find the Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents (双蛇夫人 白赤练)
sections.content:
Location: Threadbound Great Tree, after the mirror puzzle.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It closes out its region and is mandatory, so there is no route around it.

sections.title: How to Beat the Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents (双蛇夫人 白赤练)
sections.content:
What works

  • Her attack set changes through the fight; avoid committing to long combos.
  • Keep one blade's stamina in reserve for the phase change.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 13 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂). After it: Jade Dancer and Iron Fiend. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
